item.title: Rallying Cry – September 12, 2026
item.description: Scientists just witnessed cells communicating across a living body, a 13-year-old Chinese swimmer is already eyeing the Olympics, elephants outsmarted humans in a psychology test, and Céline Dion’s giant karaoke brought Paris fans together in song.
